review.why: Builds Marp slide decks with seven themes, ready templates and best-practice references.
review.summary: Creates Markdown slide decks for Marp with seven themes (default, minimal, colorful, dark, gradient, tech, business), a quick theme picker, templates with embedded CSS, image layout patterns, a quality checklist and a rule set for vague 'make it look good' requests.
strengths: Seven templates with the CSS already embedded
Theme selection rules by audience and content
Quality checklist: bullets per slide, short titles, whitespace
cautions: Some rules are tuned for Japanese (titles of 5-7 characters)
Saves to 'the project output directory', an unresolved placeholder
The 22 asset and reference files are described, not read in this review
